description: Variation of condition 1 (Approved plans) of planning permission (2017/3297) to make amendments to approved design include an increased massing at 8th and 9th floors; reduced office floorspace; provision of nine fewer hotel bedrooms; two additional stair cores; accessible outdoor terraces at 5th and 8th floors; provision of a substation at ground floor level; provision of sub-basement (-3) ancillary gym; reduced waste/recycling storage; one staff shower room (3 approved); addition of roof plant. The submission also includes detailed information relating to conditions of the approval.
decision_conditions: Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, a full air permeability test report confirming the development has achieved an average air permeability of 3 m3/h/m2@50pa shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. REASON: To ensure the development meets adopted sustainability objectives.

Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, the cooling plant hereby approved shall be installed and it shall be maintained throughout the lifespan of the development, unless an acceptable replacement system is agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.REASON: To ensure the development meets adopted sustainability objectives.

No panelised brick slip systems requiring vertical or horizontal expansion joints shall be used on any of the building facades. REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.

The works shall be carried out in accordance with the contaminated land documents approved under 2020/2627 dated 10/02/2021. Any changes to these components require the express written consent of the local planning authority. REASON: To ensure public safety from contaminants and protect controlled waters.

Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved (excluding demolition), full details illustrating the provision of 30 cycle spaces within the two cycle stores hereby approved at basement level -3, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The spaces shall include single tier stands and space for larger cycles and shall be installed prior to the occupation of the development and maintained thereafter.REASON: To ensure that a reasonable provision is made within the site for the parking of bicycles in the interest of relieving congestion in surrounding streets and improving highway conditions in general.

Biodiverse, substrate-based extensive green/brown roof (80mm minimum depth) shall be established on the roofs of the proposal, as shown on the approved plans, and maintained for the lifespan of the development. REASON: To enhance the character and ecology of the development, to provide undisturbed refuges for wildlife, to promote sustainable urban drainage and to enhance the performance and efficiency of the proposed building.

No new plumbing, pipes, soil stacks, flues, vents grilles, security alarms or ductwork shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless as otherwise shown on the drawings hereby approved or without the submission to and agreement by the local planning authority. REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.

Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, a detailed Operational Management Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, setting out measures to mitigate any noise, disturbance and wider impacts.The operation of the approved uses shall only be carried out in accordance with the details thus approved, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. REASON: To ensure that occupiers of neighbouring premises do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of general disturbance.

The Piling and any other foundation designs / investigation boreholes using penetrative methods shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved under application 2018/4613 dated 05/03/2020, otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority and Thames Water.REASON: To protect against contamination of ground water and because proposed works will be in close proximity to underground sewerage utility infrastructure.

Prior to the occupation of the development a Delivery Servicing Plan shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in consultation with Transport for London. Thereafter deliveries and servicing shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plan. REASON: To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or public safety along the neighbouring highway(s).

No plant or machinery shall be installed on the external surfaces of the building without the submission to and agreement by the local planning authority. REASON: In order to safeguard the appearance of building and the amenity of future and surrounding occupiers.

No development shall take place until a detailed demolition construction management plan has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter construction logistics shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plan. This is unless the development is carried out in accordance with the details approved under application 2017/2357 on 26th January 2018. REASON: To mitigate against adverse amenity and highway impacts.

<p>No roof plant (including all external enclosures, machinery and other installations) except for that shown on the approved roof plan, shall be placed upon or attached to the roof or other external surfaces of the building without the submission to and agreement by the local planning authority.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.&nbsp;</p>

<div>The drainage strategy shall be carried out in accordance with the documents hereby approved, unless an alternative scheme is submitted to and approved by the local planning authority, and all the approved SUDS and attenuation features shall be maintained for the lifespan of the development.</div>REASON: To safeguard against flooding and pollution.&nbsp;

Prior to commencement of works of the development hereby approved (excluding demolition), details of the passive cooling measures that are to be installed within the development to reduce the impact of summer time overheating shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This is unless the development is carried out in accordance approved under application ref 2018/1355 on 26th May 2018. REASON: To ensure the development meets adopted sustainability objectives.

The office floorspace (shown as ‘Office’, ‘Business Hub’ and ‘Flexible Meeting Room Zone’) on the drawings hereby approved shall be used only as offices (Use Class E, subsection g) and for no other use which for the avoidance of doubt shall include other uses within Class E of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 or such relevant provision as from time to time may be in force, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.REASON: To protect against an unacceptable loss of office space from the site, in line with the aims of local and regional planning policy.

The fifth floor external terraces shown on the plans hereby approved shall be accessed for maintenance purposes only and shall not be accessible by guests at any time.REASON: To ensure that the amenity of neighbours is not unduly affected.

All non-CHP space and hot water fossil fuel (or equivalent hydrocarbon based fuel) boilers must achieve dry NOx emission levels equivalent to or less than 30 mg/kWh, in line with the documents hereby approved. REASON: To protect air quality and people's health by ensuring that the production of air pollutants, such as nitrogen dioxide and particulate matter, are kept to a minimum during the course of building works and during the lifetime of the development. To contribute towards the maintenance or to prevent further exceedances of National Air Quality Objectives.

Detailed drawings/full particulars of the proposed development showing the matters set out below must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, before any work is commenced. The development, excluding demolition, shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved. - Typical window & door details including sections at 1:20; - Typical façade sections at 1:20; - Ground floor elevations and signage of the building.This is unless the development is carried out in accordance with the details approved under applications 2020/1302 on 06-01-2021 and 2018/1214 on 05-06-2018. REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.

Noise levels from any plant or machinery shall at all times be at least 5dB(A) below background levels when measured at any nearby residential window. REASON: To ensure that occupiers of neighbouring premises do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of noise nuisance from plant and machinery.

Within 12 weeks of occupation of the development hereby approved, a full BREEAM Post Construction assessment confirming BREEAM Excellent rating has been achieved, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. REASON: To ensure the development meets adopted sustainability objectives.

Full details, including samples, of the materials to be used on the external surfaces of the building, including glazing, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, before any work commences on site (excluding demolition). The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved. This is unless the development is carried out in accordance with the details approved under applications 2020/1302 on 06-01-2021 and 2018/1214 on 05-06-2018. REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.

In the event that contamination is found at any time when carrying out the approved development that was not previously identified it must be reported in writing within 7 days to the Local Planning Authority and once the Local Planning Authority has identified the part of the site affected by the unexpected contamination development must be halted on that part of the site. An assessment must be undertaken in accordance with the requirements of the site investigation, and where remediation is necessary a remediation scheme, together with a timetable for its implementation, must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in accordance with the requirements of the approved remediation scheme. The measures in the approved remediation scheme must then be implemented in accordance with the approved timetable. Following completion of measures identified in the approved remediation scheme a validation report must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in accordance with the implementation of the remediation scheme. REASON: To protect the end user(s) of the development, any adjacent land user(s) and the environment from contamination.

Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, the Air Source Heat Pumps hereby approved, including connection points to a future District Heat Network, shall be installed within the development. The Air Source Heat Pumps shall be maintained throughout the lifespan of the development, unless an acceptable replacement system is agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.”

REASON: To ensure the sustainability of the development with regard to heating and cooling equipment.

No cooking shall be undertaken at the site until the provision of means of ventilation for the extraction and dispersal of cooking smells/fumes, including details of its method of construction, odour control measures and noise levels have been submitted to and been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority in accordance with Guidance on the control of odour and noise from commercial kitchen exhaust systems. The approved scheme shall be installed before the use hereby permitted commences and thereafter shall be permanently retained.&nbsp;REASON: To safeguard the amenity of adjoining properties and to protect the general environment.&nbsp;
